balls.text: and a yorker to finish off well, outside the off stump and beats the outside edge through to the keeper

what is happening here? seriously, that's slipped from his hand yet again and it's gone down the leg-side for a wide that long that a batsman on the adjacent pitch would have hit it easily, Hodge was walking down the track there, took three steps down too and Malinga's put off by that
finally gets a yorker right, it was swinging back in and right on the length, but what a shot! backs away and gets some bat on it through backward point for a four!
now that's a wide of epic proportions, it beats Stephen Harmison's wide by at least a mile, it's slipped off his hand and goes away some place, outside the camera frame too!
and now it's down the leg side for a wide, was full yet again and the batsman's back again, misses
look at that, just look at that, he was looking to play from behind the stumps, yep, you heard it right, he's flicked away from behind the striker's stumps over the square-leg for a four!
and he's taken his stance almost close to the stumps there! yorker length and gets it on the full, hits the toe of the bat and hit back to the bowler
fuller on the off stump and driven through to long-off for only a single, good, fuller length that from the bowler, difficult to get it away
and he looks to jab it away through mid-wicket, that's a half-helicopter almost, gets it to long-on for a single alone
swing and a miss! misses the bat, the stumps and much to the Royals' delight, the keeper too, rushes away for four byes!
full-toss and on his pads, was darted in and he picks it up well, flicks it through to fine-leg for a four
outside the off stump, fuller too and he gets it away to the off side for a single
gives himself room and carts it to deep mid-wicket for a single
continues going very deep into his crease and then drives it to long-on for a single
outside the off stump and squeezed through backward point for a four, beats the fielder and gets through to the fence
very full and darting back into the left-handed batsman, he goes back and tapped down to long-on for a single

and now it's quicker one, on the middle stump too, wants to flick it away gets an outside edge through to backward point, Ojha rushes across to field that and restricts it to two, the fielder slips while getting up to that one and is down for the count

okay, so the batsman has gone really back on his crease even before the bowler has gotten to his bowling crease, gets a typically slow delivery on a length and he goes for a slog, gets an inside edge and still goes for a four!
short of length and he wants to give himself room and crack it away, again the ball does not come on as quickly he expected and the inside edge trickles down for a single

touch wider outside the off stump and shorter too, gives him room to cut the ball, he does that but straight to the fielder, they are off for a single and the throw comes in at the non-striker's end, the batsman's sprawling back
short of length and it's a tad quicker than all those slower ones he's been bowling, but it's on his pads and tucked away to fine, fine-leg for a four
low full-toss and on the off stump, driven down to long-off for another single, five singles to go with a four that over
short of length and on the middle stump, pushed to the off side for a single
full-toss this time but a lot closer to the batsman, driven to long-of for a single
four off an outside edge, wide outside the off and he was looking to throw his bat at, gets the toe of the bat and easily beats Malinga there
very short and wide, he was looking to cut it hard but it's not timed too well because the ball does not come on, rolls away into the covers
outside the off stump and on a length, guides it through to third-man for a single
very full on the middle stump, driven back to the bowler
low full-toss outside the off stump, driven through the extra-cover region for a single
shorter outside the off stump and cuts it to third-man for a single

gone miles up in the air but not long enough! gone, caught at backward square-leg! he was looking to slog it away this time, he gets it higher on the bat which does not get him the distance he needs, goes high up and Smith's positioned just for that!
punched back for a four! this was on the middle stump line with no pace taken off it, he gives it a serious whack there!

and now he's gone, first ball after the Time-out! caught by Harbhajan too! was a length ball and slower too, he was looking to go down the track but the slowness of the pace beats him, he taps it away and lobs it straight to extra-cover, half the side's gone!
another slower one but this time Binny comes down the track, pushes it into the covers for a single
slows it down considerably, 109.6 km/hr, looks to open the face of the bat but it never comes on and gets it to the backward point fielder
shorter in length and outside the off stump, he taps it to the backward point region where it's fielded off a dive, allows them to go through for a run
and now he wants to go down the track and flick it away but the ball comes slower than he expects and beats the bat, thuds into the pads
short of length and he stays rooted on his crease and wants to cut it away, beats the outside edge of the bat through to the keeper
fuller outside the off stump and that's driven through the covers for a single
bit of a good length that and outside the off stump, pushes it to the covers
fullish in length and driven to long-on for a single
and again, a slower one, but its fuller and he's tried to push it through the covers, gets an outside edge of the bat and that rushes through the fine third-man region for a four
quicker this time, on a length on the off stump, taps it through the covers for a single
shorter in length and outside the off stump, but again, it's a slower ball, 123.2 km/hr, opens the face of the bat and guides it to third-man
slower ball and on the middle stump, pushes it into the covers for a singe
round the stumps and very short, very flat and quick too, clipped around the corner and they are able to come back for the second to backward square-leg
and now slows it down a lot, outside the off stump and on a length, tapped away to the off side for a single
length ball again and easily tucked away to the leg side for a single
a very quick ball that, 101.8 km/hr and down the leg-side, left alone for a wide
keeps it right up to the bat and it's driven to wide long-off for a single
fuller on the off stump and driven to mid-off, not for runs though

gone, caught at mid-wicket! that's from round the stumps and was a length ball alright, he goes back and tries to flick it away, gets it off the middle of the bat too but unfortunately for the batsman, it's been hit straight to the fielder, was falling short of him though and does well to fall forward to gobble up the catch, a shout of "Come on!" follows!
and again! he goes down the pitch and creams it over extra-cover, this time it bounces a few times before hitting the fence, ends a good over for RR
fuller on the off stump and driven down the ground for a single
over the wicket and he looks to sweep it away, gets it off the middle of the bat and the fielder backward square-leg runs in to go for the catch, falls short of it
and immediately it's bowled shorter and into his pads, flicked away to the leg side for a single
goes down the track and hits it inside out over extra-cover to get the first six of the game!
round the wicket and straighter, not too much turn and defended back to the bowler
good stroke, off the back foot, gets it a tad shorter and he's immediately punched it through extra-cover for a single
100.3 km/hr, shorter in length and he pats it to the off side for a single
straighter one and beats the outside edge,was looking to play it down the same region
that's a quicker one attempted, was wide enough outside the off to allow the batsman to cut it late, gets it through third-man for a four, Malinga gives it a chase but in vain
quicker and outside the off stump, gets his bat down in time to tap it to short covers
tossed up on a length and he goes back and pushes it to long-on for a single
and again, very slow, almost needed to wait for some time before it arrived, flicked away to fine-leg for a single
another slower one, taking the pace off regularly here, is on a length and he taps it to the leg side

and hit up and it's caught! Not the best of strokes to play there, was another slower one and he went through with the shot, was looking to hit it over the mid-wicket region but that lack of pace beats him, it lobs high and Harbhajan is at it again, takes a good catch!
slower one and that's almost beaten the batsman, played the stroke a tad too early, almost scoops back
slows the pace down and on a length, tapped to deep cover for a single
not the best lines to bowl, it was on his pads and on a length, well flicked to fine-leg where bit of a misfield allows them to come back for the second
fuller in length and on the middle stump, driven to long-on for a single
shorter in length again and he cuts it to the point region

and now he's gone, Watto has played a rather clumsy sweep there and top-edged to square-leg! It was a lot fuller than what the batsman expected probably and he was looking to flick it, gets the top edge of the bat and it pops up easily for the fielder to run back to the circle to pouch it
on the middle stump and flicked away to fine-leg for a single
that's not quite short from the bowler, but he still goes back and cuts it late through the backward point area for a four
shorter in length and easily tucked away to deep square-leg for a single
fuller and angling into the batsman, squeezed through the leg side off the front foot and for a single
and now he's away, on the off stump and bit of turn away, gets back and cracks it through the backward point area for a four
fuller and he gets on the front foot, pushes it back to the bowler
and now he's on the back foot and pushes it to the mid-wicket area for a single
slow enough but not as tossed up, on a good length and defended to the leg side
whoa, that's been tossed up really high and he hits it inside out over the extra-cover area for a four
quicker again, flatter in length too and tapped to short mid-wicket
full enough again but he prefers to go back and flick it away to the leg side
fuller, a tad flatter and he gets his bat and pad out and defends it back
bowled him, Harbhajan has a wicket in his first over! it was full on the leg-stump and he wants to sweep it away, misses it and rattles the stumps
shortens the length a tad this time, he was probably looking to slap it over but never got to the pitch of the ball and flicks it to short fine-leg
floats it right up to the bat, and neatly plays it to square-leg for a single
and now he wants to slog it away, too full to play that stroke, misses and the keeper gets his pads together to stall the byes
and that's a shot! takes it on the full almost like he expected it to be full, and sweeps it over square-leg now
and this time he does hit it hard and long, short of length and he gets back and hits it over wide long-on for a four, beats the deep mid-wicket fielder
another one that's on a length, he wants to cut, almost too hard and gets it back to the bowler
shortens his length but cramps the batsman, who goes back and taps it down to mid-on
fullish in length from round the stumps, driven down the ground for a single
shorter in length and on the middle-stump line, tucked away behind square on the leg side for a single
quicker, on a length but angling down the leg-side for a wide
continues bowling full but this has pace taken off it, the drive is a good looking one but not in the gap on the off side
four more for Rahane now, this was pitched right up to the bat and outside the off stump, enough width to free his arms and gets it over the top, extra-cover and for a four!
shorter in length from round the stumps and he tries to punch it again, gets it straight to the fielder, one of the many on the off side
round the stumps now and slows the pace down to 126.1 km/hr, gets it off the bottom of the bat to the off side
and that's a classy cut, it was on a length and he bends his knee and gets it through the backward point region, almost uses the pace of the delivery to get it away
shorter in length, rocks back and cuts hard, fielded well at backward point
and now he goes down the track to try and flick it away, gets an inside edge to the off side, Rahane wanted the single but sent back, he's well out but gets back with a dive
shorter in length, was looking to cut it away, goes back and gets an inside edge
inside edged to the short fine-leg area, while trying to play a defensive stroke, misfielded and they go off for a single
fuller from round the stumps, driven to the covers for a single
fuller on the middle stump and swept away to fine-leg for a single
and he goes for the pull now and misses, was short of length and a charged up batsman wants to go after it!
and another one, flicked away to the square-leg for a four and Johnson continues to have a go at the batsman, Dravid goes up to the bowler and asks him again, "you want to say something?"
whoa, that's a four through mid-off, driven down the ground and Johnson has a word or two at Dravid, who seems to be in a mood to give back!
gets it on the length and on the off stump length, pushes it into the covers
short of length and he wants to cut it away again, was angling away and beats the outside edge of the bat
whoa, that's a bouncer that's shaken up Rahane, he was looking to hook it away and gets nowhere close to it, slams him on the helmet and it seems to have done enough damage for him to change his gear
again quite full and that's pushed into the covers, half-fielded and that allows the batsman to take a single off the last ball
and now fuller, the batsman expects that and gets forward to defend it to the covers
cut away for a four, it was shorter in length and outside the off stump, tapped through the covers, stands up tall while playing the stroke
swings back into the batsman and neatly flicked away to backward square-leg, there was a fielder much squarer and he needed to come around to field that
slightly wider and fuller this time and he drives it to mid-off, not well timed though
inside edged on to his pads and rolls over to the leg-side, that seamed back into the batsman who was looking to go for an off-drive
length ball outside the off and tapped to extra-cover
brings his length back and defended into the covers by the batsman, to the left of the fielder and Rayadu dives to make the save
and shot now! it was very full and wide enough to drive it through the covers, it was timed perfectly and more vitally for the batsman, it goes in the gap
good length from the bowler this time and he went for the drive without moving his feet, gets no edge on that en route the keeper
back of length yet again and he's on his back foot, stands up tall and taps it to the leg side
short of length and a tad wide outside the off stump, wants to cut it away but gets an inside edge and gathers no pace to the off side
slapped away for a boundary to finish off the game! that was a shorter one and Harbhajan was on the back foot, waiting for it and cracks it away to get the Mumbai Indians to their second IPL final
hits his pads and they are away for a quick leg-bye, the keeper appealed but Watson didn't even look at the ump, was looking to get to the ball to try and get the run-out
what a shot under pressure, that's some stroke! he gets down quickly and scoops it over the short fine-leg fielder for a four, it was a quicker one too and it's brought Mumbai back into the game
bowled him, wicket! he was looking to work it through the third-man there, but the ball was a lot quicker, was a leg-cutter and moves away from the bat, beats it and the stumps are rattled!
fuller and quicker outside the off stump, tapped to the off side and they are quickly off the blocks to get back for the second, Hodge rushes in to field but cannot stop them from coming back
the third-mans inside the circle and it's short and wide, goes for the cut but straight to the short third-man fielder
and now an inside out over wide long-off for a four, that's brought Mumbai back into the game!

oh wow, that's been dropped, the poor effort in the field continues, he was looking to sweep it over the short fine-leg, gets it off the full and goes to deep square-leg where Hodge drops a considerably simple catch
wide outside the off stump that, quite wide that and called
and he goes down the track this time, he was looking to hit it over the off side but misses the outside edge
clears his foot, swings the bat and clears the boundary for a six! was a slower one and smacked over long-on
wants to swing the bat away there, no room provided and can only get it to the deep square-leg
quicker on his pads and flicked away to Cooper at deep square-leg for a single
shorter in length and cramping him for room, was looking to play off the back foot, defended to the off side
on his pads now and quicker too, was looking to flick it away but hits his pads

gone, Pollard's chipped it straight to the fielder! on his pads yet again and he was looking for his short arm jab with the flick, comes off the middle of the bat and it's been straight to the fielder
fuller on the middle stump and hits it straight to long-on for a single
short of length and on the middle stump, he was almost squared up there, hit to the off side
fuller on the off stump and driven to long-on for a single
immediately slows the pace down, a leggie that and on a length, tucked to the leg side for a single
shot for a six! this was in his half this time, and he was almost waiting, gets his swing going and it's gone over long-off

and taken now, that's number four! was a slower one on his pads, was looking to punch it over the leg side but the slowness of the delivery seems to have defeated the stroke, spoons it to the fielder who takes it calmly
shorter in length and tapped to the deep mid-wicket area for a single
bit of cut back into the batsman, and tapped to the leg side for a single...wait a minute, that's been misfielded again, this time by Trivedi and they come back
shorter in length and he stands tall and taps it down to long-on for a single
bowled him, the stumps are on the ground! it was short of length and Rohit goes for a slog across the line, misses and it crashes into the stumps, three down and a bit of a lifeline for the Royals
short of length and on his pads, pushed to square-leg
not quite off the middle of the bat, bit of an inside half of the bat to one that's kept up to the bat, to the deep square-leg fielder
slower one and on the middle stump, almost checks his shot last moment and pushes it to mid-wicket
short of length and guides it through to third-man for a single
slows it down considerably but misses his line, defended to the leg side for a single
fullish from the bowler, 131.6 km/hr and pushes it back to the bowler
shortens his length and he's on his back foot, defending it back to the bowler
on a length and a middle stump line, tapped back to the bowler
slows it down there and it's outside the off stump, he was looking to defend at it and is beaten

gone this time, short of length and he's cut it straight to the point fielder! this wasn't the best of deliveries, looked innocuous enough to go for the cut, and he does that, probably there wasn't as much room as DK would have liked and slapped straight to the fielder
and another one, right in his slot and he's gone after it, outside the off and that gives him enough room to free his arms and hit it over long-on for a six!
on a length outside the off stump and driven through the covers for a single
fuller on the middle stump, punched down the ground for a single
and back to bowling the off stump line, slows it down too, opens the face of the bat to third-man for a single
fuller on the off stump and tapped to mid-wicket where Cooper fields
edged and four! it's been that kind of a night for Rajasthan, he opens the face of the bat and eludes the keeper by some distance for a four
on his pads and flicked away to the leg-side for a single to end another expensive over
slower on outside the off stump and tapped to the covers, straight to the fielder
on his pads and flicks it away to square-leg for a single
length ball outside the off stump and driven through the covers for a couple of runs, there's a collision between Smith and the bowler...
yorker length ball and he gets his bat down in time to get away for a single, another throw comes in and misses the stumps but this time, there's a back-up available and no overthrows
and now its been slogged away for a six! it was on a length and angling away, jabs it over mid-wicket for a six to get to his 50!
down the leg-side and he looks to glance it away, seemed to have got some pad and the ump still calls it a wide
short of length and that's beaten the backward point fielder en route the third-man region for another four, I dare day he should have stopped that one
and now Karthik drives it through extra-cover for a four, this is a very good shot, fullish in length and he pounces on that length, beats the fielder for a four
short of length and he's on the back foot, taps it away to the leg side and off for a single

slower one again and he was looking to pull it away, hits his body because he's played the shot too quickly, Karthik calls him over for a single and there's another shy at the non-striker's end that goes for an overthrow
wow, that's been caressed away by Smith for a four through extra-cover, it was fuller outside the off stump and he's leaned into it and drilled it, shot sir!
takes all the pace off the ball, he waits for it and then gently taps it to the off side for a single
shorter in length and tapped to the off side for another quick single
shorter in length and that's been pushed to the leg side, they get a single but wait, Watson's thrown it to the non-striker's end and not only does it miss the stumps but also the fielders backing up
that leg-stump line yet again and flicked away to the leg side for a single
on his pads and was looking to swing the bat away, hits his pads and rolls over to the leg side
slower from the bowler this time, and tapped to the leg side for a couple of runs before the fielder can come in
and he looks to slog it away this time, was a length ball and on the leg stump line, Yagnik does well to collect it and whip the bails off, the batsman's in
fuller on the middle stump and there is a bit of caution in pushing that through to long-on for a single
very full, tailing into the batsman and gets it off the middle of the bat straight to long-off for a single
outside the off stump and at 135.4 km/hr, was on a length and he was looking to throw his bat at that, misses the outside edge
short of length and he cuts it hard, straight to the point fielder though
punches the fuller delivery outside the off stump and gets it away to deep cover on the bounce

fuller and chipped straight to long-on, caught! that was hit off the middle of the bat, it was a slower one and that gets it to scoop up to the fielder who looked like he wasn't quite at the edge of the fence, one down now
on his pads yet again and he flicks it to mid-wicket for a single, Watson fields well but does not stop him from taking a single
slower one on his pads, tucked round the corner for a single
pushes it fuller on the bat and punched to the off side, followed by calls of 'yeah, yeah Bapu' from the keeper
shorter in length with the keeper up to the stumps now, tapped to long-on for a single
goes down the track and wow, that's been tonked over long-on for a six, it was on his pads alright but never looked like he had hit it hard, punched away!
shorter in length and outside the off stump, 123.9 km/hr, cuts it away but goes on the bounce to the point fielder
on a length and opens the face of the bat to third-man for a single
slows it down as much as he had done to the first delivery, but this is a touch wider and a tad on a length and can only push it to the covers
fuller on the middle stump and driven to long-on for a single
quicker and angling back into the batsman from a length, defended to the off side for a single
short arm jab through the leg side, the long-on was in position and it went a few yards to his right but went quickly too, he dives well there but cannot stop it
and that's another that seems to have been stuck in the bowler's hands, shorter too and very wide outside the off stump, lets it go through to the keeper
slower one and very full, reads that one well and spanked it over the bowler for a four, goes on the bounce and hits the fence
fuller length ball and it's tapped back to the bowler, who jumps to his right to field that one
takes the pace off completely and he hits the same area, the gap between deep mid-wicket and long-on, does not hit it hard and wants a second but the fielder is in quickly
fuller and quicker from him, tapped away rather well to deep mid-wicket for a coolly taken two runs
and now looks to go down the track, slows it down there, 112 km/hr, shortens the length and the batsman has to tap it away to the leg side, Tare wanted a single but sent back
shorter in length and on the middle stump line, just does not come on again and it's pushed to the off side, spotted some movement too
keeps it up to the bat and on the off stump, pushes it to extra-cover

and now pulled away to the left of the deep square-leg fielder for a four, was a short ball and he looked to peel the leather of the ball there, did not look like it had come off the middle of the ball but does well to hit the gap
and now wants to swing it across, punched straight to mid-off this one
length ball outside the off stump and he wants to crack it through the covers, gets it decently well off the bat but not in the gap
short of length and angling away from the batsman, pats it to mid-off for a single
slower one from the bowler and right up to the bat, that's the length he was looking for and gets it over mid-wicket for a four!
short of length but stump to stump from Faulkner, he gets his bat and pad together and defends it to the leg side
a very slow ball this, 104 km/hr, lobbed up outside the off stump and he was looking to blaze it away but manages to drive it only to long-on for a single
on the middle stump line, was on a good length too which makes the batsman go for a pull, it comes on quicker than he expected and it's mistimed to square-leg
outside the off stump and on a length, slower too and he manages to cut it away to deep cover for a single
and he now looks to slog it away but the ball comes on quicker this one, gets it away to mid-off, runs off for a quick one
another one bowled like a leg-cutter, on the middle stump and it does not rise up too much, pushes it to extra-cover
slower one, it was lobbed up to the bat, outside the off stump and wants to drive it away, gets it only to the covers
fullish delivery and tailing back into the batsman, pushes it to mid-on for a single
shorter in length again and tapped to the off side where Dravid needs to run to his left to get close to it, single for the batsman
a yorker-length ball and he digs it out well, hit to mid-on where the fielder rushes in and throws it down to the non-striker's end, misses it
fuller outside the off stump and drives well off the front foot, this time Dravid at extra-cover dives to his left and fields well
short, wide and cut away for a four! Binny had to run across to his right and he gets there in time, only to misfield again, gets his hand on it and almost over-runs it for a four
fuller and on his pads and that's neatly clipped away through mid-wicket for a four, the fielder at mid-on, Trivedi takes time to go after it but that was rushing away anyway
outside the off stump and short of length, wants to crack it away but gets the cut shot going to the third-man fielder alone
and another misfield, this time from Dravid, was hit on the up and tapped to extra-cover, he tries to slide around but fumbles it
slower one outside the off stump and on a length, waits for it and pushes it into the covers
pushes the length further up to the bat now and he looks to drive it away, an outside edge rushes to the third-man fielder
outside the off stump and on a good length, has a swing at the bat but misses, through to the keeper
and again, the ball does not come on to the bat, he was looking to hit it through the line, was a good length ball too but gets only an inside half of the bat
outside edged for a four! it was on a length and he looks to heave it away, gets the outside edge and it rushes away to the fence
wide outside the off stump, looked like it was a slower one too and the batsman cannot get his bat to it, that's called a wide
this is a lot closer to the stumps, movement back into the batsman who was looking to flick it away, hits the pads
and beaten again! was on a length and bit of movement away, was looking to punch it through the covers, beats the outside edge
shorter in length and angling away, guides it through to third-man, that runs off the bat but for a single
short of length and he's swivelled around and tonked away for a six! good hook that!
short length and that one angles away from the batsman, lets it go through to the keeper
cut hard and that's misfielded by Rahane at point, went quickly to the fielder, but straight enough, got a hand to it but still seeps through to the fence
and now he looks to swing across the line, he had been trying to avoid the shot all this while but gets defeated by the slow leg-cutter
and looks to swing it away, slower in pace this time and mistimed it on to the pads
shorter in length and cut straight to the fielder at extra-cover, was hit hard enough and bounced high after hitting the turf
shorter in length and bit of a swing away from the batsman, beats the edge as he looks to flay it away
outside the off fuller, he was looking to get it over long-off, does not come off the middle and scoops up high but evades the extra-cover fielder
